items.summary: Maintain a small, capacity-gated pipeline. Strongest candidate: complicated.work, score 84, scaffold lifecycle, existing site/ops capabilities, and an existing launch-readiness prerequisite. Pipeline backups: deadlymaracas.com and driveford.net, both requiring verified launch-readiness artifacts before any build admission. For complicated.work, the bounded factory packet must cover: audience and site brief; reusable scaffold/template; initial content seed; metadata, sitemap, canonical, and crawlability baseline; analytics readiness without inventing configuration; affiliate readiness only with an owner-approved registered tracking ID; compliance disclosures and consent; security and release evidence; named owner; measurement baseline; and single-diff rollback. Current evidence shows analytics is not configured, compliance is failing on banner/consent checks, and security/operations clearance is not evidenced. Therefore launch remains blocked and no domain, spend, deployment, or public launch is authorized. Exactly one next step: CTO verifies the existing complicated.work launch-readiness artifact against the owner, legal, security, measurement, and rollback checklist and records one disposition: ready for isolated preview, blocked with owner, or evidence-needed. Do not create duplicate work while delivery capacity is saturated at 10/10 slots.
